## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`./gradlew test`, `npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] User-facing text translated in both `en` and `es`
- [ ] No secrets, real guest data or recorded real responses
- [ ] Breaking changes (if any) are described above
